sentences.text: Heard on the question of admission.
Criminal appeal is admitted for final hearing.

Also, heard on I.A.No.8005/2025, first application see  of sentence on behalf of the appellant Pawan S/o Kailash Ratho  been convicted under sections 366 & 376(1) of the IPC and Sect Section 3 of the POCSO Act, 2012 and has been sentenced for 7   years R.I. and fine with default stipulations vide judgment da  in Special case No.226/2021 by the Special Judge (POCSO Act) &
 Indore.
The sentence of imprisonment are ordered to be run con  Counsel for the appellant submits that the trial court  convicted and sentenced the appellant.
The appellant has alrea  jail incarceration of more than 3 years.
He is every hope of s  appeal.

The final hearing of this appeal will likely to take l  prayer is made for suspension of jail sentence of the appellan  bail.
 Counsel for the respondent/State has opposed the appli Heard.
The appellant/accused has been convicted due to the fact that the trial Court assessed the age of the victim as 16 years, 11 months and 2 days.
There is serious challenge to the age of the victim.
Otherwise, the victim has disclosed the consensual relationship between her and appellant including the solemnization of marriage.
The appellant has already undergone jail incarceration of more than 3 years.

Considering the above, the application is allowed and it is directed that the execution of remaining jail sentence passed against the appellant shall remain suspended and he be released on bail upon his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 18/2/2026 and on such further dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Registry during the pendency of this appeal.
